name: io.github.ictinnovations/pbx-mcp
description: Inspect and control Asterisk (AMI) and FreeSWITCH (ESL) PBX servers from your AI assistant.

environmentVariables.name: ASTERISK_AMI_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname or IP of the Asterisk server. Set this to enable the Asterisk tools.

environmentVariables.name: ASTERISK_AMI_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Asterisk Manager Interface port. Defaults to 5038.

environmentVariables.name: ASTERISK_AMI_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Connect to AMI over TLS. Set true if tlsenable=yes in manager.conf.

environmentVariables.name: FREESWITCH_ESL_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname or IP of the FreeSWITCH server. Set this to enable the FreeSWITCH tools.

environmentVariables.name: FREESWITCH_ESL_PORT
environmentVariables.description: FreeSWITCH inbound event socket port. Defaults to 8021.

environmentVariables.name: FREESWITCH_ESL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Event socket password from event_socket.conf.xml. Defaults to ClueCon, which you should change.

environmentVariables.name: PBX_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Unlocks call control. When false the server is read-only and the originate and hangup tools are not registered at all. Placing a call on a live trunk costs real money, so leave this off unless you mean it.

environmentVariables.name: PBX_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per command timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.
